response.sql:
WITH group_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    s.zoneref AS site_code,
    st.healtheval AS health_safety_status,
    AVG(s.gbsize / NULLIF(s.spanmin, 0)) AS avg_size_per_minute,
    COUNT(*) AS scan_count
  FROM scans AS s
  JOIN sites AS st ON st.zoneregistry = s.zoneref
  WHERE s.chronotag >= '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274'
    AND s.chronotag <= '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797'
  GROUP BY s.zoneref, st.healtheval
),
with_overall_mean AS (
  SELECT
    gm.*,
    AVG(gm.avg_size_per_minute) OVER () AS mean_group_average
  FROM group_metrics AS gm
)
SELECT
  site_code,
  health_safety_status,
  avg_size_per_minute,
  scan_count,
  avg_size_per_minute - mean_group_average AS amount_above_mean
FROM with_overall_mean
WHERE avg_size_per_minute > mean_group_average
ORDER BY amount_above_mean DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: A scan counts toward its group's scan count even when gbsize or spanmin is missing or spanmin is zero; those rows are excluded only from the average ratio. The mean is over non-NULL group averages.
